author: Engineezy
description:
Should I keep working on this?
•••
I threw together this prototype to test if this concept would work.  Using cardboard and hot glue to build the conveyor belt, and some other stuff lying around the shop, it actually turned out to be sort of functional.  To give an element of control, I used strings to tilt the bike forward and back, and when you time it right you can actually get some sweet air off the jump. Let me know your thoughts!
